23283880.pre: Сайт эксперта за 30 минут и ваши вопросы

fix: async function(){const id=location.pathname.match(/\/(\d{6,})/)[1];const plan=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('planR'));const p=plan[id];if(!p)return id+' no plan';for(let i=0;i<25;i++){const r=document.querySelector('[name="rule"]');if(r&&r.value.length>50)break;await new Promise(x=>setTimeout(x,1000));}const f=document.querySelector('form');const fd=new FormData(f);fd.set('save','1');fd.set('Mailing[content]',p.content);if(p.kind==='mail'){fd.set('Mailing[subject]',p.subj);fd.set('Mailing[preHeader]',p.pre);}fd.set('Mailing[schedule_type]','in_time');fd.set('Mailing[need_send_at]',p.at);fd.set('Mailing[need_send_from]',p.at);[...fd.keys()].filter(k=>/FileList\[files\]\[[^\]]+\]\[/.test(k)).forEach(k=>{const m=k.match(/FileList\[files\]\[([^\]]+)\]/);if(m)fd.set('FileList[files]['+m[1]+'][for_delete]','1')});const r2=await fetch(f.action,{method:'POST',body:fd,credentials:'include'});return id+' '+r2.status+' '+p.at+' rule='+(fd.get('rule')||'').length+' content='+p.content.length;}
